items.quote: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation
items.claim: The people brought what Moses had commanded to the front of the tabernacle of the congregation.
items.place: before the tabernacle of the congregation

items.quote: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD
items.claim: The whole congregation came forward and stood before the LORD.
items.place: before the tabernacle of the congregation
